P094.authors: B Peng, Z Li, X He, L Xu

complete_examples.text: Critical design considerations must address the coupled damping interaction between under-block and under-rail isolators to achieve synergetic vibration suppression, thereby optimizing energy dissipation efficiency across the track system.
To find out the energy dissipation of the pad damping in the track service process and whether large damping will harm the train running safety, it is necessary to carry out more in-depth research.
